notes.title: Guilty Gear Isuka Update - OST now included!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/FTA7de3.jpg[/img]

As of today's update, [i]Guilty Gear Isuka[/i] now comes bundled with its official Original Soundtrack, complete with tags and cover art. Encoded in MP3 at over double the bitrate of the OGG files used ingame, you should find these a little more pleasant on the ears and convenient for the playlists. You can find the soundtrack in the [i]GUILTY GEAR ISUKA[/i] folder in your steam/steamapps/common directory.

Stay tuned in the coming weeks...

notes.title: Guilty Gear Isuka Update
notes.content:
Today we've made a few changes to how Steam handles Guilty Gear Isuka. Guilty Gear Isuka's configuration menu can now be used through Steam by choosing "Configure Settings" on startup. 

Additionally, Guilty Gear Isuka now makes use of Steam Cloud saving; saved data such as boost points, factory unlocks, and in-game/config menu settings can be accessed from any computer as long as you have cloud saving enabled.

We have a few more things planned in the future as well, and hope to keep you posted on them!
